integrity: Exact algebraic reduction with classical Schur criterion; computational checks support but do not replace proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar homogeneous two-field poroelasticity, fixed K and coupling, sufficiently small positive flow coefficient times time step; strict stability/instability regimes only, no equality classification, multidimensional PDE or global order guarantee.
title: Parity-sharp weak-flow stability of fixed-sweep BDF2 poroelasticity splitting
